app.name: FontCraft
dashboard.title: FontCraft Studio
dashboard.empty.title: Welcome to FontCraft
dashboard.empty.body: Create a custom font from your handwriting. Press New font to begin.
screen.soon.title: Coming in a later milestone
screen.soon.body: This screen is being ported from FontCraft v3.
storage.full.title: Storage is full
storage.full.body: Your latest change could not be saved. Export a backup now so nothing is lost.
exit.title: Leave FontCraft?
project.none.title: No project open
project.none.body: Open or create a project first.
project.new.title: New font project
project.new.name: Font name
project.delete.title: Delete this project?
project.delete.body: “{name}” and all its glyphs will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
migration.title: Copying your old projects
migration.body: Please wait. Your originals are not touched.
migration.done: Your old projects were copied. The originals are untouched.
migration.failed: Some old projects could not be copied ({n}).
editor.title: Glyph editor
editor.none: Pick a character on the Glyphs screen first.
editor.variants.note: Up to 4 versions. They alternate to look like natural handwriting.
editor.legacy: This glyph came from FontCraft v3 as a bitmap. It is shown as a reference layer; drawing on top adds vector strokes.
editor.temp: Simple drawing tool. The smooth pen engine, Bezier pen, zoom and select arrive in a later milestone.
editor.leave.title: Unsaved drawing
ligatures.title: Ligatures
ligatures.empty.title: No ligatures yet
ligatures.empty.body: Add rules to merge pairs like fi, fl, or a Bengali conjunct into one glyph.
kerning.title: Kerning pairs
kerning.empty.title: No kern pairs yet
kerning.empty.body: Add pairs like AV, To, We to tighten awkward gaps.
preview.title: Live preview
preview.note: Drawn with your own glyphs. Text rendered by the exported font arrives with real font export.
export.title: Export
export.backup.title: Project backup
export.backup.body: A .fcproj file holds everything: glyphs, metrics, ligatures and kerning. You can restore it on any device.
export.font.title: Font files
export.font.disabled: OTF, TTF, WOFF and WOFF2 export is not available yet. It arrives with real font export, and each format will be verified before its button is enabled.
export.restore.title: Automatic backups
export.restore.none: No automatic backups yet. One is made every 20 glyph saves and when the app pauses.
export.stats: {drawn}/{total} glyphs · {variants} with variants · {kern} kern pairs · {lig} ligatures
fontset.title: Font settings
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
editor.pen.need3: Need at least 3 points to close
editor.pen.hint: Tap to add a point. Drag to curve it. Tap a point to switch smooth and sharp.
editor.select.hint: Tap a stroke or path to select it. Selected paths show points you can drag.
editor.displayOnly: These only change how it looks here. A font has no colour.
shortcuts.gestures: Two-finger tap: undo. Three-finger tap: redo.
editor.import.note: Fits an SVG into the glyph box as editable outline. You can draw over it or erase parts of it.
editor.ref.nothing: Nothing dark enough at this cut-off. Raise it and try again.
jobs.legacy.title: Converting your handwriting to vectors
jobs.legacy.body: Old picture glyphs are being traced so they can become a real font. The originals are kept as a reference.
export.bitmaps.title: Pictures from FontCraft v3
export.bitmaps.body: {n} drawings are still pictures. Convert them to editable outlines so they can become a font.
scan.title: Scan
scan.empty.title: Bring in your handwriting
scan.empty.body: Print the template from the Glyphs screen, fill every box, then photograph or scan the page and open it here.
scan.align.ok: Grid aligned to the printed boxes
scan.align.weak: Could not find the printed lines. Adjust the grid by hand.
scan.label: Ignore the printed label strip
scan.import.policy: If the glyph already has a drawing
scan.import.none: Nothing to import. Fill in the boxes or lower the darkness cut-off.
scan.import.skipped: {n} cells had no matching glyph in this project
